I implemented `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` in `minidb/parser.py`, and all 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I did not run the rest of the test suite, and I did not use the real tokenizer, since it is still a stub. The parser tests build their tokens by hand.

I also deleted one test, `test_delete_without_where_matches_all_rows`, from `tests/test_parser.py`. It expected `DELETE FROM t` to parse to `DeleteStmt("t", Literal(True))`. Another test in the same file, the grammar in `minidb/types.py` and the `DeleteStmt` docstring all say a missing WHERE is `None`. Both expectations can't hold at once, so I followed the docstring and the earlier test.

If the validator still has the original version of that test, it will fail against this parser.
